memes: 'Saxophone Gets Louder' — video freezes on chaos while a full-blast sax suddenly drowns everything, like an 80s breakdown.
'Kinda Chic to…' — sentence starter that reframes something deeply unglamorous as secretly bougie (e.g., 'kinda chic to eat cereal at 2am alone').
Tornado Squirrel resurgence — the iconic mid-twister squirrel photo is flooding X again as a reaction image for every unhinged news cycle.
'It's a Clock' — slow-burn reveal trend where creators dramatize a situation they 'didn't quite understand at the time,' ending in delayed realization.
'How Could This Day Get Any Better' — creator holds a mundane object (a rock, a receipt) and presents it as an impossible jackpot find.
'What I Looked Like When' — pairs an innocent childhood photo with a savage, unhinged caption about what was actually happening.
Luke Bryan's 'Down Goes the Whiskey' roast — comment sections on the official video are a brand battle zone, with Southwest Airlines and others piling on.
